g.text: Fully differential telescopic OTA with continuous-time CMFB
(a) Telescopic signal core and bias mirror
(c) CMFB error amplifier and current mirrors
Unit PMOS dimensions are 20 µm × 10 µm.
Gate at PC. Source, drain and bulk tied to the upper node.
Repeated net labels are connected across panels. NMOS bulks go to VSS and PMOS bulks to VDD, except the MOS capacitors in (d).
VBP = VDD − 2.2 V. The two 200 kΩ resistors average SP and SM at SENSE.
